sanitizers.scope: All 26 core units, platform adapter, simulator, destination batch domain/native fixtures and test host (31 units).

guarantees: Every original component remains represented with strict lossless/native mapping or an explicit per-row mapping failure. No display conversion, case folding, normalization, truncation or auto-renaming.
All mapping/exact-duplicate grouping finishes before native queries. Exact equal mapped names share one retained probe while every source row and group count remains.
Native lookup, location/length/Win32 diagnostics and existing metadata retain independent states. Denial/unreadable metadata never becomes Missing.

Positive reported-object groups compare full scoped native IDs while targets remain held. Key indexing excludes scope ordering; compare_identity still checks scope/scheme/volume/object/generation/nonzero qualification. Same key bytes from foreign scopes cannot match.
Exact name equality and reported object-ID equality are separate. Hard links are not namespace-equivalence proof; missing matches are never a collision-free claim.
Sealed immutable result only after complete mapping/probing/grouping. Parent and opened targets retain independent worker-owned lifetime after job abandonment.
256-step cooperative advances, cancellation/resume, once-only completed probes across yields, bounded names/rows/components, nonallocating exception poison and terminal no-I/O behavior.
validation_notes: All 109 exported source hashes, including test host and both platform adapters, matched on remote extraction and still match locally. Documentation-only updates explain repository-wide fingerprint changes after compilation.

Mac initial current core build took 5.100 s (new core compile/library/two links plus CMake regeneration). New fixtures built in 6.531 s (four compile/link steps plus regeneration). Final domain fixture two-step update took 3.136 s. Earlier same-project two-step simulator increment was 3.676 s, a comparable but different fixture workload.

Remote builds compiled all three new units, archived and linked both binaries, plus CMake regeneration. Linux 6.711 s (2.0/0.1 s configuration/generation); Windows 19.482 s (8.7/0.7 s configuration/generation). Inspected Windows Ninja compile/link intervals explain the longer build: parallel core/native/domain compiles 3.326/4.950/9.018 s. No stale executable accepted.
Output hashes/timestamps, compiled units and all 26 new RUN markers checked; elapsed time alone was not used as freshness proof.

Direct sanitizer builds used no cached objects, all 31 units: Mac/Linux/Windows 48.940/116.614/67.346 s. Previous different-fixture 30-unit builds were 49.845/120.513/55.657 s; this fixture set establishes its own baseline. Exact flags/units/source hashes and compiler emitted source names checked.
Successful builds gated tests. All 52 focused cases passed per host with supported halt-on-error sanitizer options, strict warnings as errors, and no diagnostics.

Native fixtures exclusively created task scratch directories and qualified hard links vs duplicate names, evidenced missing names, held-parent path replacement, final dangling link inspection and target replacement lifetime on all three OSes.
Diagnostics hashed and zero-owner checks passed before removal. Full scratch-root audits ended empty. Current normal verified builds remain. No GUI launched or production mutation added.
Windows project writes/temp remained on V:. Mac TMPDIR explicitly beneath mounted S8T. Linux used its local task workspace and TMPDIR.
limitations: Distinct missing names can still collide through native case, normalization, short-name or other alias rules. No filesystem advertisement supplies that proof here.

reported_object_leader is positive evidence of matching reported scoped IDs only; absent value proves neither object difference nor collision freedom. Native membership/metadata can change after queries.
No source-object binding, self/descendant safety decision, frozen operation plan, operation capability, conflict choice, loss consent, mutation, publication or UI generation protocol supplied.

The row/name/component budget bounds this in-memory batch, not total process memory, caller input construction, native query temporary storage, diagnostic strings or available OS handles. Probe-context reservations are conservative; large/disk-backed operation inventories remain required.

One owning worker. Native probes may contain multiple blocking syscalls; allocations, comparisons and destruction can outlast a time slice. Cancellation can retry an incomplete current probe but never earlier completed probes.

WP-01 remaining checklist items and acceptance stay open; native equivalence, remaining inventory/capability services, source acquisition and pane/worker/large-view integration still require implementation. WP-02..08 not started.
